Joining BMI as a songwriter or composer is free.
claims.note: BMI FAQ: "What is the fee to join as a songwriter or composer?"
claims.howToCheck: BMI blocks automated visitors, so a person must read this page: BMI's FAQ 'What is the fee to join as a songwriter or composer?'. A web search of BMI's own pages found it states there are no fees or annual dues for songwriters and composers. Confirm that is still what it says.

claims.statement: Joining ASCAP as a songwriter is free. (ASCAP calls the fee waiver temporary, so this is worth watching.)
claims.note: ASCAP page titled "Join ASCAP for Free"; $50 applies to publisher-only memberships.

claims.statement: Joining The MLC as a member is free.
claims.note: The MLC FAQ: "Does it cost anything to become a Member of The MLC?"

claims.statement: Spotify needs editorial pitches at least 7 days before release (and suggests about 2 weeks); we plan for 3 weeks.

claims.statement: A songwriter is normally affiliated with one PRO at a time, and the same songs are not registered with two.
claims.howToCheck: Read BMI's and ASCAP's membership terms and confirm a writer can belong to only one PRO at a time. This one is not stated plainly on a single page, so a person has to confirm it.
